message: You know those moments when you’re feeling a little too proud of your preparedness? I had one of those when the lights went out last week, and I remembered all the tips I’d picked up about power outages. This resource is a great way to brush up on what to do when the power goes out, from keeping your food safe to staying entertained. It’s good to be ready, right? Who else has had that 'I told you so' moment during a blackout?
